summary: The lane couldn't get this past its own validation in 2 rounds — /review didn't clear this to ship: analytics:daily job is registered but scheduler.start() is never called (only pricing:sync-prices is started) — real_days/OHLC/ARCA-score never advance after prices sync, so the 'building history' UI never resolves in production; scripts/seed-prices.ts purge (purgeSyntheticHistoryOnce) is guarded only by a filesystem marker decoupled from the DB file — a DB restore/copy without that marker would silently wipe all real accumulated price_history/analytics. No PR opened; it needs a human.
